answer_1.quote: We tackle the challenging task of figurative language generation: hyperbole generation from literal sentences.

answer_2.quote: We report the BLEU and BERTScore metrics for generated sentences compared against human written hyperboles.

answer_4.quote: We evaluate the generation results from the 71 testing literal sentences. Each pair of texts (ours vs. a baseline / human reference) is given preference (win, lose or tie) by five people with proficiency in English.
answer_4.guideline: We use a set of four criteria adapted from  to evaluate the generated outputs: 1) Fluency (Flu.): Which sentence is more fluent and grammatical? 2) Hyperbolicity (Hypo.): Which sentence is more hyperbolic? 3) Creativity (Crea.): Which sentence is more creative? 4) Relevance (Rel.): Which sentence is more relevant to the input literal sentence?
